citations.quote: Fixed shares and fluctuating market values only leave one “degree of freedom” in this equation: cash.

The PCF relays the actual amount that would have satisfied a creation or redemption from the prior business day (actual cash) and a number of fields that are used to calculate the amount of cash expected to be part of a transaction on the current business day (estimated cash).
There is a catch-22, however: A fund that has not launched does not have a NAV, but to launch, the fund needs a PCF that requires the NAV as one of its inputs.
Paying financing charges on the money used to buy the ETF

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: The PCF is the sponsor's published recipe of basket shares plus cash for one creation unit. Because share counts are fixed, cash is the single degree of freedom that reconciles the basket's fluctuating market value to the CU's NAV; at launch the same recipe is bootstrapped via fixed, floating, or zero-cash seeding.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: The Portfolio Composition File, the Cash DOF & Fund Seeding
